newsitem.title: LATVIA: DEPOSITORY TO OFFER NON-BOURSE PAPER DVP.
newsitem.headline: DEPOSITORY TO OFFER NON-BOURSE PAPER DVP.

text.p: The central Depository on Thursday said it will handle delivery versus payment (DVP) transactions in a month's time, both with paper not quoted on the bourse and those carried out by intermediaries who are not bourse members.

"By way of bringing the clearing system in line with international standards, the depository (in these cases) will handle both the process of delivering securities and money," Martinsh Rikshis, president of the depository, said at a news conference.
The finance ministry approved corresponding amendments to the securities law on May 15.
"The depository has the proxy from commercial banks to carry out payments for securities transactions on their behalf from their accounts with the central bank," Rikshis added.
DVP transactions for securities quated on the stock exchange are currently handled by the bourse, which could change in two or three years' time, Rikshis said.
"We are all interested in seeing liquidity concentrated in the bourse," Rikshis said.
"Therefore, for the time being we have not suggested amendments to the law, following the bourse's request."
